title: knowledge-atoms v1 atom
description: A single atom in the knowledge-atoms catalog. Discriminated by `type`. knowledge-atoms holds the primitives for RAG, semantic memory, and AI knowledge graphs — entity types, relationship types, provenance records, fact types, and confidence primitives.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the claim or fact encoded in this atom. 1.0 = certain; 0.0 = pure speculation.

source_ref.description: Reference to the authoritative source for this atom. May be a URL, a knowledge-atoms URI (knowledge-atoms://atoms/...), or a free-form citation.
